contraindications.t: Chronic asymptomatic hyponatraemia (risk of osmotic demyelination)

cautions.t: Use only for severe symptomatic hyponatraemia or raised intracranial pressure

adverse_effects.t: Over-rapid sodium correction (osmotic demyelination), fluid overload, hyperchloraemic acidosis, phlebitis
